question: Identify the body part that does NOT contain involuntary muscles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biceps**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Biceps** are voluntary muscles, meaning they are under conscious control.
 
• These muscles are part of the skeletal muscle group, which facilitates movement by attaching to bones.
 
• The primary function of the biceps is to flex the elbow and rotate the forearm.
 
• Skeletal muscles, including the biceps, are striated in appearance due to their fiber structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Involuntary Muscles**:

 
 
• These muscles operate without conscious control.
 
• Examples include muscles found in the heart, digestive system, and respiratory system.
 
• They play essential roles in bodily functions like heartbeats and digestion.
 
 
 
• **Skeletal Muscles**:
 
 
• These are voluntary muscles attached to bones.
 
• They are responsible for body movements and maintaining posture.
 
• Skeletal muscles are characterized by their striated appearance under a microscope.
 
 
 
• **Cardiac Muscle**:
 
 
• The heart muscle is involuntary and striated.
 
• It contracts rhythmically and continuously to pump blood throughout the body.
 
• Unlike other involuntary muscles, cardiac muscle can generate its own electrical impulses.
 
 
 
• **Smooth Muscle**:
 
 
• Found in walls of internal organs like the stomach, intestines, and blood vessels.
 
• These muscles are non-striated and involuntary.
 
• They help in functions such as peristalsis and regulation of blood pressure.
